The canonical implementation confirms it: src/pair_lj_expand.cpp:115 'fpair = factor_lj * forcelj / rshift / r;' and :409 the same in single(). The doc (doc/src/pair_lj_expand_sphere.rst:46-53) gives exactly the lj/expand energy with Delta = (d_i+d_j)/2, so there is no alternative reading. The force is therefore too large by a factor rshift^2.
